children: SUNation Energy amended its secured revolving line of credit with affiliate MBB Energy to extend the facility’s maturity to April 15, 2027. The credit line, previously upsized on April 14, 2026 to $1.5 million, carries an 8% annual interest rate, payable monthly, and permits borrowings, repayments and reborrowings. The amendment enhances near-term liquidity while maintaining access to working capital from a related-party lender.

: Extend maturity and maintain liquidity flexibility
